description: Five development tasks on a small CommonJS package: a package entry point, exports = module.exports, object-literal methods, prototype methods and aliased re-exports. Graders are hidden from the agent and run only after the session ends.

repository.license: MIT (part of the Repogi source tree)

tasks.prompt: Requests to the root path are broken: after the trailing-slash middleware runs, a request for "/" has an empty path. Fix it so "/" stays "/" while "/users/" still becomes "/users". Do not change deprecated code. Keep the existing test suite (`npm test`) passing.

What does `require('nodekit')` return, and which function implements it? Answer in a short paragraph without modifying any files. End your answer with one line of the form `CITATIONS: path:line, path:line, ...` citing where the package entry point is declared, the module that exports the value, and the implementing function.
Rename the validator's `check` method to `isNonEmpty` everywhere it is defined and used, including tests. Behavior must not change, and `checkAll` keeps its name.

A session must count as expired exactly at its deadline (when the elapsed time equals its time-to-live), not only after it. Change that behavior and keep everything else as it is. Keep `npm test` passing.

Give the logger middleware an optional prefix: `logger(lines, prefix)` writes each line as the prefix followed by the existing text, and without a prefix the output is unchanged. Then make the verbose preset log with the prefix "[kit] ". Keep `npm test` passing.
